items.headline: Oregon's look for USC trip tops best uniforms of college football Week 4
items.description: At a base level it's an all-white set for Oregon this week, but it's the details that make the uniform really pop.

items.headline: September surprises: Our unexpected all-portal team
items.description: Unlikely stars a month ago, here are the biggest portal surprises at every position.

items.headline: JaMarcus Shephard pays tribute to Mike Leach with gameday outfit
items.description: Shephard, who worked for Leach in 2016 with Washington State, wore an ensemble similar to one of Leach's looks during Oregon State's win over Montana.

items.headline: Arizona visits Washington State in Week 4
items.description: Arizona (2-1) at Washington State (1-2), Sept. 26 at 7:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Caden Pinnick throws 2 TD passes, runs for one and Washington State beats Duquesne 48-7 for 1st win
items.description: — Caden Pinnick threw his first two passing touchdowns this season and ran for another to lead Washington State to a 48-7 victory over Duquesne on Saturday for the Cougars' first win.

items.headline: Washington State's Tony Freeman has torn ACL, out for season
items.description: Washington State's Tony Freeman, the team's top returning receiver and kick-return specialist, has suffered a torn ACL and will miss the rest of the season.
